caption: The drawing depicts a bedroom with blue and green damask-patterned wallpaper and a blue floor. There is a wooden bed with a tall, ornate headboard and matching bedspread and pillows with a red circular pattern. Next to the bed, there is a wooden nightstand with a white basin and pitcher set on top, and a towel draped over its side. A wooden chair with a reddish cushion and a piece of white fabric draped over the arm is positioned in front of the nightstand. Another green upholstered chair stands on the left side of the image, next to a pink and green floral-patterned carpet. In the center is a wooden table, elaborately carved, with a purple tufted armchair and a round green upholstered ottoman. On the table sits a gold lamp, some books, and a vase of flowers. A large chandelier with gold detailing and white candles hangs from the ceiling. The far wall has a window with blue and white striped curtains, gathered and trimmed with swags and gold tiebacks, flanked by two wall-mounted candle sconces. To the left of the window stands a tall, gold-framed plant stand with a pink vase and leafy plant. Above the bed hang two framed pictures, one of a reclining figure. A fur rug is laid beside the bed on the blue floor. The overall color scheme includes various shades of blue, green, gold, and wood tones, with floral and decorative patterns throughout the furnishings and textiles.
title: Bedroom, 1882
